page_title: EVE 0-0 AST | Everton v Aston Villa 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Simon Hooper has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+5' Simon Hooper blows his whistle as Thierno Barry (Everton) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+1' Michael Keane (Everton) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
90+1' Everton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' James Garner (Everton) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
90' Everton fail to score from a corner as Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) leaps to collect the ball.
88' The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
87' Merlin Rohl (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simon Hooper has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
85' Merlin Rohl (Everton) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
83' Here is a change. Lamare Bogarde is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Victor Lindelof (Aston Villa).
83' That will be all from Ollie Watkins who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Donyell Malen (Aston Villa).
80' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
79' The attendance for today's match is 52114.
76' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) was too forceful with his tackle and Simon Hooper interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
75' The substitution is prepared. Thierno Barry (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Beto.
73' A quickly taken corner by Everton.

72' Emiliano Martinez makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Michael Keane (Everton) after a cross from the side. The ball is out of play. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harvey Elliott (Aston Villa) replacing Emiliano Buendia.
70' Simon Hooper shows the yellow card to Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) for a heavy challenge.
69' Jack Grealish (Everton) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.
66' A substitution has been made. Tim Iroegbunam is replaced by Merlin Rohl (Everton).
65' A yellow card for a tackle by Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton). Simon Hooper doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
64' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
64' James Garner (Everton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
62' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
62' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent. The referee signals a corner kick to Everton.
62' Jake O'Brien (Everton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
59' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
57' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card for infringement.
55' The corner from Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is cleared away by the defence.

54' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' The foul by Beto (Everton) was seen by Simon Hooper who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.

51' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa win a corner kick.
49' Jack Grealish (Everton) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.

48' James Garner (Everton) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Unai Emery probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa). He is replaced by Evann Guessand.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' The foul by Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simon Hooper.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
44' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
44' The resulting set piece from Everton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Everton.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
40' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jordan Pickford, who smothers the ball.
38' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is penalised for holding. Simon Hooper signals a set piece.
36' Beto (Everton) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
36' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
34' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Matty Cash (Aston Villa) for a tough tackle.
33' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Michael Keane (Everton) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
32' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Everton.
32' Jack Grealish (Everton) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
30' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) brings an opponent down and Simon Hooper interrupts the game.
27' Beto (Everton) commits a foul during an attacking move.
26' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) and blew his whistle.
26' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
24' The move breaks down when Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post.
23' The corner from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez.
21' James Tarkowski (Everton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
20' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Simon Hooper blows his whistle for an infringement.
17' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
16' Emiliano Martinez makes a brilliant save! Jack Grealish (Everton) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal. Everton win a corner.
16' Beto (Everton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
14' Some neat passing and movement from Everton as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
11' Michael Keane (Everton) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
10' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
9' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) commits a foul and Simon Hooper immediately signals a free kick.
8' Beto (Everton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
8' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
7' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) plays a through ball but overhits it.
5' Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
3' Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) picks up an injury.
2' Beto (Everton) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
1' The match has just started.
Aston Villa will kick the game off.
Simon Hooper is the one to supervise the game today.
